digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter; capability detection and validation
propositions: Epic-field capability contract validation must occur post-run and refuse reports that cannot be verified, with the verdict written to run_metadata.json and non-zero exit on failure

Capability call sites must be guarded at runtime using isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback, and capability-absent vs capability-raised conditions must be reported distinctly on the bridge_alerts channel rather than silently swallowed

The dormant inbound absence-probe port including SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, and three probe_remote implementations must be deleted, with the operator deletion ruling and rationale recorded outside the repo

The live DC harness regression criterion was amended from 'still GREEN' to 'did not regress' because the harness was already failing before this epic's changes landed, due to a pre-existing cause in commit c87afedba8
